message.jaymoskingdoms.tidefishing.cry.0: You'd hook the sea's own children in front of us?
message.jaymoskingdoms.tidefishing.cry.1: Put that line down! Those are our kin!
message.jaymoskingdoms.tidefishing.cry.2: The Deep Mother sees what you do to her young!
message.jaymoskingdoms.tidefishing.attac: The Tideborn saw you hook a fish, and take it as an attack on their kin.
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.cry.poachin: Thief of the tide! Guards, the shallows!
